title: 수동태 응용 (고난도)
scope: 4형식 수동, 5형식 수동, 조동사 수동, 부정문/의문문 수동, by 외 전치사, 영작, 오류 찾기

questions.prompt:
다음 능동태의 수동태로 *불가능한* 것은?

My mom sent me a letter.
choices: I was sent a letter by my mom.
A letter was sent to me by my mom.
A letter was sent me by my mom.
questions.answer: A letter was sent me by my mom.
questions.explanation: send 류 4형식은 직접목적어를 주어로 할 때 간접목적어(me) 앞에 to 필수. 'A letter was sent *to* me' (○), 'A letter was sent me' (×). give/send/lend/show/teach 등은 to 사용.

questions.prompt:
다음 능동태를 수동태로 바르게 옮긴 것은?

Claude taught me grammar.
choices: I was taught grammar by Claude.
Grammar was taught of me by Claude.
questions.answer: I was taught grammar by Claude.
questions.explanation: 4형식(teach me grammar) → 간접목적어(me)를 주어로 한 수동: 'I was taught grammar by Claude.' 직접목적어를 주어로 하면 'Grammar was taught to me by Claude.'

questions.prompt:
다음 능동태를 수동태로 바꾸세요. (5형식)

My friends call me 차닐.
questions.answer: I am called 차닐 by my friends.
questions.explanation: 5형식 수동: 목적어(me)가 주어(I)로, 목적격보어(차닐)는 주격보어로 그대로. 'I am called 차닐.'

questions.prompt:
빈칸에 알맞은 형태를 고르세요.

This problem ___ in five minutes.
questions.explanation: 조동사 + 수동 = 조동사 + be + p.p. → can be solved. 'solve-solved-solved'.

questions.prompt:
다음 능동태를 수동태로 바꾼 것은?

You must finish the homework.
questions.explanation: 조동사 must + 수동 = must + be + p.p. = must be finished.

questions.prompt:
다음 능동태 부정문을 수동태로 바꾸세요.

My mom didn't make the cake.
questions.answer: The cake was not made by my mom.
alternatives: The cake wasn't made by my mom.
questions.explanation: 부정문 수동: be + not + p.p. didn't make = 과거 부정 → was not made (또는 wasn't made).

questions.prompt:
다음 능동태 의문문을 수동태로 바꾸세요.

Did 차닐 make this app?
questions.answer: Was this app made by 차닐?
questions.explanation: 의문문 수동: be동사를 문장 맨 앞으로. 과거 의문 'Did make' → 'Was made'. 어순: Was + 주어 + p.p. + by 행위자?

questions.prompt:
빈칸에 알맞은 전치사를 고르세요.

I was surprised ___ his answer.
questions.explanation: be surprised *at* ~ 또는 *by* ~ 둘 다 '~에 놀라다'. 현대 영어에서는 by가 더 흔하지만, at도 정답 (특히 격식체 / 놀라움의 *원인*을 강조할 때). 시험에서 둘 다 인정.
밀(wheat)이 빻고 반죽하고 굽는 과정으로 빵이 됨 = 재료 *변형* → made *from*. 재료가 형태 그대로 보이면 made *of* (예: a desk made of wood).

questions.prompt:
다음 두 문장의 차이는?

(A) The movie was exciting.
(B) I was excited.
questions.explanation: -ing 형용사 = '주는 쪽' (exciting movie = 흥분시키는 영화). -ed 형용사 = '받은 쪽' (I'm excited = 내가 흥분받음). interested/interesting, bored/boring 모두 같은 패턴.

questions.prompt:
다음 문장을 영어로 옮기세요. (수동태 사용)

그 책은 100만 명에 의해 읽혔다.
questions.answer: The book was read by 1 million people.
alternatives: The book has been read by 1 million people.
questions.explanation: 수동 과거 = was + p.p. → was read. (read의 p.p.는 read, 발음 [red].) 100만 명 = 1 million people.

questions.prompt:
다음 문장을 영어로 옮기세요. (수동태 사용)

이 영상은 차닐 쌤에 의해 만들어질 것이다.
questions.answer: This video will be made by 차닐 쌤.
alternatives: This video will be created by 차닐 쌤.
questions.explanation: 미래 수동 = will be + p.p. → will be made. by 뒤에 행위자.

questions.prompt:
다음 문장에서 잘못된 부분을 찾아 고치세요.

The bus is arrived at the station.
questions.explanation: arrive는 자동사 → 수동태 불가. 'The bus arrived at the station.' (과거) 또는 'The bus has arrived at the station.' (현재완료).

questions.prompt:
다음 문장에서 잘못된 부분을 찾아 고치세요.

I am interested with K-pop.
questions.explanation: be interested *in* ~ = '~에 관심 있다'. with가 아닌 in. 외워야 하는 굳어진 표현.

questions.prompt:
다음 능동태를 *현재완료 수동태*로 바꾸세요.

Fans have downloaded the app 1 million times.
questions.answer: The app has been downloaded 1 million times by fans.
alternatives: The app has been downloaded 1 million times.
questions.explanation: 현재완료 수동 = have/has been + p.p. → has been downloaded. 주어 'the app' 단수 → has.
